svg.title: Gasherbrum Ii — mountain relief
svg.desc: Southwestern snow slopes from the high glacier. Upper summit pyramid, long southwest ridge, broad snow apron and ice terraces. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Olaf Rieck. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gasherbrum2.jpg. License: Public domain, . Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
